read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Bind PDF to XMP Metadata
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, bind it to a PdfXmpMetadata object, optionally modify XMP fields, and save the updated PDF.

create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.title: Create PDF with XMP Metadata from Scratch
create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to generate a new PDF document, build a fresh XMP metadata block using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, add common metadata properties, and save the PDF with the embedded XMP.

detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.title: Detect XMP Metadata and Annotate PDF
detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.description: The example checks whether a PDF contains XMP metadata and, if present, adds a text annotation to the first page before saving the modified document.

set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Set BaseUrl in PDF XMP Metadata
set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign a BaseURL value to a PDF's XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified file.

set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.title: Set XMP CreatorTool Property to Application Version
set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to obtain the current assembly version and assign it to the XMP CreatorTool metadata field of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-xmp-nickname-property.title: Set XMP Nickname in PDF Metadata
set-xmp-nickname-property.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, assign a custom value to the XMP Nickname property via the Metadata dictionary, and save the updated file.

remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.title: Remove Nickname Element from PDF XMP Metadata
remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access its XMP metadata dictionary, delete the "xmp:Nickname" entry, and save the modified document.

modify-xmp-creator-property.title: Update XMP Metadata Property in PDF
modify-xmp-creator-property.description: Demonstrates how to read, modify, and write an XMP metadata property (e.g., dc:creator) in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The example loads a PDF, updates the metadata value, and saves the result.

update-multiple-xmp-properties.title: Update Multiple XMP Metadata Properties in a PDF Atomically
update-multiple-xmp-properties.description: Demonstrates how to modify several XMP metadata fields in a PDF and save the changes in a single atomic operation using a temporary file and file replacement.

update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.title: Update XMP Metadata in PDF and Save
update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, replacing its XMP metadata via the Metadata dictionary, and saving the modified document to a new file.

insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.title: Copy XMP Metadata and Insert PDF Pages
insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to copy XMP metadata from a source PDF to a target PDF, concatenate the documents to insert pages, and reapply metadata to preserve it in the final file.

split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Split PDF into Single Pages While Preserving XMP Metadata
split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to split a multi‑page PDF into separate one‑page PDFs and copy the original XMP metadata to each new document using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.title: Copy XMP Metadata and Merge PDFs
copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to copy XMP metadata from one PDF to another using Aspose.Pdf and then merge the source pages into the target document.

export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Export XMP Metadata from PDF to Side‑car File
export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, retrieve its XMP packet using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and write the metadata to a separate .xmp side‑car file.

replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Replace PDF XMP Metadata from External File
replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to import an external .xmp file and replace the existing XMP metadata block in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.title: Update PDF XMP Metadata with Overwrite Warnings
set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.description: Demonstrates how to read, modify, and overwrite built‑in and custom XMP properties in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, while logging warnings when existing non‑empty values are replaced.

log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.title: Log XMP Metadata Size Before and After Modification
log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.description: Shows how to read the XMP block size, update a metadata entry, and log the size again using Aspose.Pdf.

log-original-xmp-metadata.title: Log Original XMP Metadata from PDF
log-original-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, write it to an XML log file for audit, and then continue processing the PDF.

clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Clear All XMP Metadata from a PDF
clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: Shows how to remove all custom XMP metadata entries from a PDF while keeping the mandatory PDF schema header using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Remove XMP Metadata from PDF
remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete the XMP metadata block from a PDF by clearing the Document.Metadata dictionary and saving the document with Aspose.Pdf.

load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.title: Handle Encrypted PDFs with PdfFileMend BindPdf
load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.description: Demonstrates how to catch encryption errors when binding a PDF with PdfFileMend, decrypt the document using a password, and re‑bind the unencrypted version.

decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.title: Decrypt PDF, Update Creator Metadata, and Re‑encrypt
decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF, modify its Creator metadata, and then re‑encrypt it with new permissions using Aspose.Pdf.

persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Write and Verify PDF Metadata (BaseUrl, Creator, Nickname)
persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set custom and standard PDF metadata using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and read the values back to verify they were written correctly.

store-extract-unicode-nickname.title: Store and Verify Unicode Nickname in PDF Metadata
store-extract-unicode-nickname.description: Demonstrates how to set a Unicode nickname in the PDF Title metadata, save the document, and verify persistence across multiple saves using Aspose.Pdf.

read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.title: Benchmark XMP Metadata Extraction from Large PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to read XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and measures the time required for large documents (500+ pages). Includes a warm‑up run to exclude JIT overhead.

update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.title: Update CreatorTool Metadata for PDFs in a Folder
update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.description: Shows how to enumerate PDF files in a directory and set the Creator metadata property using Aspose.Pdf.

update-xmp-property-in-pdf.title: Update XMP Property in PDF via Command Line
update-xmp-property-in-pdf.description: Shows a simple command‑line tool that loads a PDF, adds or updates an XMP metadata property, and saves the modified file.

read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF on UNC Path
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF located on a network share via a UNC path and extracting its XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfXmpMetadata.

list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.title: List XMP Namespaces in a PDF
list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, retrieve its XMP metadata packet, and enumerate all XML namespace URIs declared in the XMP document.

add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.title: Generate Minimal XMP Metadata When PDF Lacks Metadata
add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.description: The example checks a PDF for existing metadata, copies it if present, and otherwise creates minimal XMP metadata (title and creation date) using the PdfXmpMetadata facade.

export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF XMP Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.description: Shows how to read XMP metadata from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and serialize it into a formatted JSON file for downstream consumption.

compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.title: Compress PDF with High Compression and Read XMP Metadata
compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.description: The example loads a PDF, applies high‑compression optimization settings, saves the compressed file, and then reads and prints any XMP metadata stored in the resulting document.

add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.title: Add XMP Timestamp Metadata to PDF
add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.description: Creates a PDF with visible text and attaches XMP metadata that includes a standard creation date and a custom timestamp property.

extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF to Dictionary
extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, read its XMP metadata and return the entries as a flat dictionary of string key/value pairs.

set-default-creator-metadata.title: Set Default Creator Tool Metadata in PDF
set-default-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to obtain a default CreatorTool value from appsettings.json or an environment variable and assign it to a PDF's Creator metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.title: Conditional BaseFolder Injection for HTML to PDF Conversion
disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.description: Shows how to convert an HTML file to PDF with Aspose.Pdf while using a configuration switch to disable BaseFolder injection, useful for test environments or SDK versions where the property is absent.

refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.title: Refresh Creator Metadata for PDFs
refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.description: Shows how to scan a repository of PDF files and update each document's Creator metadata field and modification date using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-xmp-metadata-against-xsd.title: Validate XMP Metadata in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
validate-xmp-metadata-against-xsd.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and validate it against the official XMP XML schema using an XML schema validator.

update-pdf-xmp-baseurl.title: Update XMP BaseUrl in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-xmp-baseurl.description: Demonstrates how to set or replace the XMP BaseUrl metadata property of a PDF document based on the current request host URL, using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract Raw XMP Metadata from a PDF
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve its embedded XMP metadata as a UTF-8 XML string using the PdfXmpMetadata facade.

read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf__v2.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts its XMP packet using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, parses the XML and reads Dublin Core properties such as title and creator.

set-pdf-creator-metadata__v2.title: Add Creator Metadata to PDF Document
set-pdf-creator-metadata__v2.description: Shows how to create a reusable extension method that sets the Creator metadata on an Aspose.Pdf.Document, which is saved with the PDF file.
